trans-unit.source: Hashing method for the frontend: Defines salted hashing method to use. Choose "Portable PHP password hashing" to stay compatible with other CMS (e.g. Drupal, Wordpress). Choose "MD5 salted hashing" to reuse TYPO3 passwords for OS level authentication (other servers could use TYPO3 passwords). Choose "Blowfish salted hashing" for advanced security to reuse passwords on OS level (Blowfish might not be supported on your system TODO).
trans-unit.target: Hashing-metode til frontend: Definerer saltet hashing-metode, der bruges. Vælg "Portable PHP password hashing" for at forblive kompatibel med andre CMS (f.eks. Drupal, Wordpress). Vælg "MD5 saltet hashing" for at genbruge TYPO3-adgangskoder til godkendelse på OS-niveau (andre servere kan bruge TYPO3-adgangskoder). Vælg "Blowfish saltet hashing" for avanceret sikkerhed for at genbruge adgangskoder på OS-niveau (Blowfish understøttes muligvis ikke på dit system TODO).
